clauses.text: The hosts describe the envelope as a long‑missing physical artifact central to the Dark Skies investigation and plan to open the material for unrestricted public use and scrutiny.

The meeting is intended to convene researchers, experiencers, policymakers, ethicists, and faith leaders to develop reproducible interview protocols, data‑integration workshops, and briefings for agency participants.
